description: This file defines the class Zend_XmlRpc_Response, which handles the creation, loading, and serialization of XMLRPC response messages within the Zend Framework. It includes methods for managing return values, encoding, fault detection, and XML serialization.

classes.name: Zend_XmlRpc_Response
classes.description: Handles XMLRPC response construction, loading, and serialization, including support for fault responses and encoding management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the response object with optional return value and type.

methods.name: setEncoding
methods.description: Sets the character encoding for the response and propagates it to the XML-RPC value system.

methods.name: setReturnValue
methods.description: Sets the return value and optional type hint.

methods.name: _getXmlRpcReturn
methods.description: Converts the stored return value into an XML-RPC compatible value.

methods.name: isFault
methods.description: Determines if the response is a fault response.

methods.name: getFault
methods.description: Returns the fault object if the response is a fault.

methods.name: loadXml
methods.description: Parses an XML string to load an XML-RPC response, setting fault if invalid or a fault response.

methods.name: saveXml
methods.description: Serializes the response into an XML string.

methods.name: __toString
methods.description: Returns the response as an XML string.
